entities.name: Vatti
entities.description: Young elf rogue and lifecrafter on Avishkar, a renegade who aided Ajani and later designed the Sting Strike thopters.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: Planeswalker who met Vatti on Ghirapur's rooftops.

entities.name: Grandmother Pashiri
entities.description: Renegade contact captured by the Consuls and later freed.

entities.name: Tamni
entities.description: Fellow renegade who described the capture of Renegade Prime.

entities.name: Dhiren Baral
entities.description: Set the deadlock trap that held Chandra, Nissa and Pashiri.

entities.name: Chandra
entities.description: Planeswalker freed from the deadlock trap.

entities.name: Nissa
entities.description: Planeswalker freed from the deadlock trap.

entities.name: Mr. Wiggles
entities.description: Mechanical butterfly Vatti uses for communication.

entities.name: Dhund
entities.description: Consuls' stronghold of tunnels beneath Gonti's night market.

entities.name: Sting Strike
entities.description: Wasplike thopters designed by Vatti to deconstruct Phyrexians.

entities.name: Shadowblayde Craftworks
entities.description: Business Vatti opened after the war.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion during which Vatti designed the Sting Strike.

events.summary: Vatti meets Ajani on Ghirapur's rooftops and tells him Pashiri has likely been captured.
events.quote: She informed him that Pashiri had likely been captured by the Consuls.

events.summary: Vatti leads Ajani to a renegade safe house where Tamni describes Renegade Prime's capture.
events.quote: Tamni , a fellow renegade, described the Consuls capturing Renegade Prime

events.summary: Vatti organizes young lifecrafters and plans to infiltrate the Dhund.
events.quote: Vatti organized a group of young lifecrafters to aid in the search

events.summary: Vatti reveals her true name and Ajani reveals he is White Cat.
events.quote: She revealed her true name, Vatti, as a gesture of trust and solidarity.

events.summary: Guided by Vatti's bird, Ajani frees Chandra, Nissa and Pashiri from Dhiren Baral's deadlock trap.
events.quote: freeing Chandra , Nissa and Mrs. Pashiri from it

events.summary: Shadowblayde takes part in the Renegades' attack on the Consulate's Spire.
events.quote: Shadowblayde was part of the Renegades' attack on the Consulate's Spire.

events.summary: During the invasion Vatti designs the Sting Strike thopters, then opens Shadowblayde Craftworks.
events.quote: Vatti designed a type of wasplike thopters dubbed the "Sting Strike"

relations.quote: Determined to help, Vatti led Ajani through the chaotic and vibrant city of Ghirapur
Shadowblayde was part of the Renegades' attack on the Consulate's Spire.
